name: Panda Luck

features.name: Sticky panda respins
features.description: Three or more pandas stick and start three respins that reset.

features.name: Panda multipliers
features.description: More pandas mean a higher multiplier on the bet.

review:
Panda Luck is a 3x3 slot with a smiling panda as the bonus symbol. Three or more pandas turn sticky and trigger a respin bonus with three respins, which reset every time another panda lands.

During the bonus, each panda adds to a multiplier applied to your bet, so the more pandas you collect, the bigger the final payout. BGaming lists a maximum multiplier of 2,124x. Despite the small grid and cute theme, BGaming rates it very high volatility. The 97% RTP is excellent, and the bonus arrives frequently, about once every 95 spins on average. It's quick, simple and fun for short demo sessions.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 95 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
